title: Roos completion of strict coefficient-extension representatives
statement: For the actual coefficient systems of [def-coef-ringed-sequence-site], fix a coefficient extension E→L and its functor C from derived completed E-modules to derived L-systems. Suppose direct is a natural strict complex model of C on good complexes, its evaluations are the specified finite scalar complexes, and its successor transition maps agree with the specified quotient tensors. Then there is a natural isomorphism C(QP) completed by the canonical derived sequence limit ≅ the specified Roos scalar-extension complex of P. For each level n its inverse followed by the canonical limit projection, the restricted evaluated model map and the scalar-restriction factorization equals Q of the actual nth Roos projection. This conclusion fixes the projection maps, in addition to identifying objects.

source.place: Integral operations and normalized coefficient reduction model.

proof.text: Assemble the restriction-evaluation comparisons into the specified isomorphism of strict towers. Apply the canonical projection-normalized Roos comparison to the restricted complex. Whisker the given representative isomorphism and the strict tower isomorphism, then use naturality of the canonical projections and the derived-factorization cocycle to prove the projection equation.

mathlib_searches.query: Roos mapping cone total right derived inverse limit strict towers natural isomorphism canonical projection
mathlib_searches.results: Eight mapping-cone comparison lemmas, including CochainComplex.mappingCone.mapHomologicalComplexIso; no theorem giving this coefficient-tower derived-limit comparison with its canonical projections.
Seven comparison lemmas, including mapHomologicalComplexCompIso and its component equations; used to compare exact restriction and evaluated complexes.
Mathlib gives adjunction uniqueness; no specialized completed coefficient-system theorem. Project StrictRoosComparison supplies the derived-limit ingredient.

mathlib_searches.query: Compose a strict scalar extension representative with a Roos derived limit comparison and preserve each specified projection.
mathlib_searches.results: ModuleCat.preservesFiniteLimits_extendScalars_of_flat in Mathlib.Algebra.Category.ModuleCat.Descent and ModuleCat.ExtendRestrictScalarsAdj.unit are scalar-extension ingredients, not the projection-normalized derived-limit assembly.

lean.statement:
theorem coefficientExtensionRepresentativeRoos_exists
    (SE : CoefficientDerivedSystemCalculus l E W)
    (direct : (integralOperationsGoodComplex l E W).FullSubcategory ⥤
      CochainComplex (coefficientSequenceModules l L W) ℤ)
    (directEvaluation : ∀ n : ℕ,
      direct ⋙ (coefficientSequenceEvaluation l L W n).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ) ≅
        (integralOperationsGoodComplex l E W).ι ⋙ integralScalarFiniteComplex l E L ι W n)
    (htransition : IsCoefficientExtensionStrictTransition l E L ι W direct directEvaluation)
    (model : integralOperationsGoodLocalization l E W ⋙
      coefficientExtensionSystem l E L ι W SE A ≅ direct ⋙ DerivedCategory.Q) :
    ∃ e : integralOperationsGoodLocalization l E W ⋙
        (coefficientExtensionSystem l E L ι W SE A ⋙ coefficientSequenceLimit l L W) ≅
          integralScalarOnGood l E L ι W,
      ∀ (P : (integralOperationsGoodComplex l E W).FullSubcategory) (n : ℕ),
        e.inv.app P ≫
            (coefficientSequenceProjection l L W n).app
              ((coefficientExtensionSystem l E L ι W SE A).obj
                (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P.obj)) ≫
            (coefficientFiniteDerivedRestriction l L W n).map
              ((coefficientSequenceDerivedEvaluation l L W n).map (model.hom.app P) ≫
                (coefficientSequenceEvaluation l L W n).mapDerivedCategoryFactors.hom.app
                  (direct.obj P) ≫ DerivedCategory.Q.map ((directEvaluation n).hom.app P)) ≫
            (scalarReductionRestriction l L W n).mapDerivedCategoryFactors.hom.app
              ((integralScalarFiniteComplex l E L ι W n).obj P.obj) =
          DerivedCategory.Q.map (coefficientExtensionRoosProjection l E L ι W P.obj n)
